name: Chattle!
summary:
Chattle! is an interactive 1v1 auto battler with a variety of options to customize your character.

It is meant to be played with the chat members of a streaming service of your choice.
Players get assigned a fighter randomly when they first join. This includes stats, one of 7 classes and 11 weapon types, over 250 visual items and attacks! They then can queue up for battle with other chat members and see whose fighter is the strongest.

While this is an autobattler, meaning the fighters do the attacks themselves, players have some agency over their character by either changing their fighting style to use a specific type of attack more often, or unlock new attacks in different elements. They then can build the perfect loadout that crushes any opponent!.

The game also features cosmetics in different rarities, aquired through random rolls. Who can build the coolest looking fighter? Who gets the first legendary Wodden Sword? Who just wants to look cute? There are near endless possibilities.
